name: Flowise
description: Visual agent builder acquired by Workday; the repository has been archived.
descriptionZh: 被 Workday 收购的可视化 Agent 构建器；仓库已归档停更。
keyFact: Flowise is an Apache-2.0 visual agent builder acquired by Workday in August 2025; development stopped on 29 July 2026 and the GitHub repository was archived, so the code remains self-hostable but receives no security patches, and Flowise Cloud was set to shut down on 30 November 2026.
keyFactZh: Flowise 是 Apache-2.0 的可视化 Agent 构建器，2025 年 8 月被 Workday 收购；2026 年 7 月 29 日停止开发、GitHub 仓库已归档，代码仍可自托管但不再获得安全补丁，Flowise Cloud 计划于 2026 年 11 月 30 日关停。
caveat: End-of-life: repository archived August 2026, no further development or security patches. Listed here as a caution, not a recommendation.
caveatZh: 已终止维护：仓库于 2026 年 8 月归档，不再开发、不再提供安全补丁。此处列出仅为风险提示，并非推荐。
